verdict.rationale: Stripe documents ordering, registering, configuring, and monitoring readers from the Dashboard (docs-32). Readers can be registered by order number or serial number right after unboxing (docs-20, docs-5), and no-code options, including Tap to Pay in the Dashboard mobile app, let a founder take in-person payments without building an integration (docs-26, docs-50). The account sign-up and approval flow and any timeline for hardware delivery or reaching first payment are not documented, so the same-week outcome is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of the sign-up/approval process and its turnaround, hardware shipping times, and independent or hands-on confirmation of going live within a week.
